production.calculation: For resource x, sum parent rates: weight * parent subtype baseProduction / parent production requirement. Effective hybrid requirement = hybrid baseProduction / summed parent rates. If only one parent makes x, use that contribution alone. This preserves the stated relative output weights at equal environment modifiers; the offspring genome and Apiary conditions further affect final output.

rivalry.pairRule: A hybrid inherits the native rivals of both parents. If its two parent species are rivals, it also rivals both parent species.
rivalry.hybridRule: Two hybrids rival if any parent of one is rival to any parent of the other.
